stem: Draw the FBD of blocks & count the number of forces acting on block(s): (a) block m on smooth surface (b) block m on block m₂, both on ground (c) block m on smooth incline at angle θ (d) sphere A in smooth V-groove with 60°-60°-60° angles (e) block M pushed by force F against a wall
